title: Complete build plugin contract v2 migration
goal: Close the two remaining rc∈{0,1} and no-path-construction gaps left after fdaa186, add the missing grep-assertion test, and verify npm test green.

steps.description: Add two failing tests to build-test.sh before touching implementation: (a) SPEC-15-rc: call _build_stage_run_inner with empty first arg, assert rc=1 (not rc=2) — confirms return 2 at plugin.sh:114 is the violation; (b) SPEC-16-nopaths: grep plugin.sh for hardcoded 'scope-manifest.md' path constructions and assert the count is 0 — this test must go RED against the current code because lines 78–79 still exist. Run tests and confirm both RED for the stated reasons before any implementation change.

Fix return 2 at plugin.sh:114 in _build_stage_run_inner arg-validation block: change 'return 2' to 'return 1'. No disposition-bearing summary is possible here (output_summary_json is not yet resolved), so just change the exit code. The error message already logs the problem; the engine treats rc=1 as non-fatal and reads the (absent) result as a structural failure per ADR-054.

Remove the fallback path constructions from build_stage_run (plugin.sh lines 78–79: 'local scope_manifest=...' and 'local plan_json_path=...'). Replace with: require ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS to be set and non-empty; extract both paths from it; if either is missing, emit error and return 1. The ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS block that already exists (lines 82–88) becomes the only source of both paths. Existing SPEC-13 (state_file absent → rc=1) is unaffected because it fails before path resolution; existing SPEC-6/7 (ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS provided) continues to pass.

Run npm test (or bash plugins/agent/build/tests/build-test.sh) and confirm all tests green including the new SPEC-15-rc and SPEC-16-nopaths. Run bash scripts/check-coverage.sh and confirm the 29% floor is not broken. State the red step (SPEC-15-rc: _build_stage_run_inner empty args returned rc=2 before fix; SPEC-16-nopaths: grep found 'scope-manifest.md' at lines 78–79 before removal) in the PR body per CLAUDE.md.

notes: 1. fdaa186 already completed: manifest v2 fields (result_contract:2, valid_verdicts, router budget, primary:true, provides.role/events, cleanup), unconditional disposition+reason in summary.sh on all branches, ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS path resolution, SIGINT→rc=1+disposition:interrupted, missing-plan→rc=1+disposition:broken, and SPEC-1 through SPEC-14 tests. 2. The return 2 at line 114 is in _build_stage_run_inner's arg-validation guard; the engine never triggers it (build_stage_run always passes all 5 args), but it is still a strict rc∈{0,1} violation per ADR-054 §4b and must be fixed. 3. Removing fallback paths from build_stage_run (step-3) does not affect _build_stage_run_inner callers in tests — they pass explicit paths as arguments. 4. No other test calls build_stage_run without ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS set except SPEC-13 (which exits at the state_file check before reaching path resolution). 5. The SPEC-16-nopaths grep should check for the specific string 'scope-manifest.md' appearing as a path construction (not in comments or error messages) in plugin.sh — use grep -v '^#' to exclude comments before counting.
